Definition: Giddel, the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of 'Solomon's servants'
BiblicalUsage: Giddel = "very great"; 1) the head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel; 2) the head of the descendants of Solomon's servants returning from exile with Zerubbabel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
